description: Enum representation on the JSON wire. proto3 JSON accepts a value by name or by number and emits the name for known values. Unknown values are emitted as their number so that an SDK which predates a value can still carry it.

vectors.rationale: Baseline. A known value given by name round-trips as that name.
proto3 JSON accepts the number on input and emits the name on output.
The zero value is a proto3 default and is omitted from output.

TaskState currently defines 0 through 8. An SDK that does not know a value must carry the number through rather than substituting a sentinel, or a version bump breaks every older intermediary at once.
Baseline on a second enum, so a failure on Role is distinguishable from a failure on TaskState.
Same forward-compatibility requirement as enum.unknown_number, on Role.
